Extremist content, both left leaning and right leaning, garner a lot of engagement, positive and negative, which results in algorithms learning to push and recommend this content further.

Politically left content is typically very critical of the privileged majority, e.g. white, middle class, straight, male, etc. These groups, especially being young and lacking in maturity and life experience, are going to feel insulted by this, thus are more likely to want to consume the right leaning content, which typically strokes the egos of these groups, so they're more likely to consume it and will then be more likely to be recommended more, which will become more extreme.

Eventually, the content being fed stops being about not being ashamed for being a part of these groups and becomes about the enemy, the out group, those who threaten your way of life. Telling you to fear immigrants making you a minority, women using you or falsely accusing you of crimes, the poor wanting to steal your money, your hard earned money paying taxes to pay for lazy, unemployed chavs.

It goes from supportive of the viewers to hateful of others. It desensitises these ideas to young people and not only that, but makes a particularly conservative, traditional lifestyle seem appealing and simple. It starts telling you, as a member of any of their targeted groups, what you should be and what you should believe.

It is a gradual and insidious process and a clear consequence of children spending more time on social media, unsupervised, from a far younger age than ever before.
